problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: size 51 units
* Package Bravo: size 63 units
* Package Charlie: size 44 units
* Package Delta: size 32 units
* Package Echo: size 53 units
* Package Foxtrot: size 62 units
* Package Golf: size 46 units
* Package Hotel: size 55 units
* Package India: size 64 units
* Package Juliet: size 68 units
* Package Kilo: size 36 units
* Package Lima: size 49 units
* Package Mike: size 38 units
* Package November: size 62 units
* Package Oscar: size 38 units
* Package Papa: size 39 units
* Package Quebec: size 34 units
* Package Romeo: size 51 units
* Package Sierra: size 42 units
* Package Tango: size 32 units
* Package Uniform: size 31 units
* Package Victor: size 61 units
* Package Whiskey: size 60 units
* Package X-ray: size 34 units
* Package Yankee: size 66 units
* Package Zulu: size 63 units
* Package Aster: size 33 units
* Package Backslash: size 38 units
* Package Bracket: size 70 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
